description:
Today on The Matt Walsh Show, we’re living in a world where it’s getting harder and harder to tell what’s real and what’s manufactured. Everything seems fake, from the content you scroll past to the systems you’re told to trust. So if that’s true, how did we get here, and is there any way back? We’ll discuss. Also, Fox investigates the problem of foreign, non English speaking truckers on the road. It's worse than you think. Also, the internet melted down over a post by a Christian husband revealing his wife's promiscuous past.
